artifact.title: Invoice lifecycle
artifact.trigger: Billing staff creates an invoice from approved job costs and change orders for a project.

transitions.guard: Invoice references project and client and includes only approved change orders

story.goal: Create an invoice from approved job costs and change orders so the client receives a formal billing document.
steps: Billing staff selects the approved job costs and change orders to include on the invoice.
Billing staff generates a draft invoice from the selected costs for the project and client.
Billing staff reviews the invoice for accuracy and sends it to the client.
story.outcome: An invoice is generated from approved costs and sent to the client for payment processing outside the system.
